provider.description: ToastProvider supplies the toast context and renders the toast viewport. Place it once around the part of the application that needs to create toasts.

elements.name: duration
elements.description: Default display duration in milliseconds. Defaults to 3000. A value of 0 keeps toasts visible.

elements.name: exitDuration
elements.description: Default exit animation duration in milliseconds. Defaults to 300.

elements.name: toastNumberLimit
elements.description: Maximum number of active toasts. Defaults to 5; older active toasts are dismissed when the limit is exceeded.

elements.name: tooltip
elements.description: Enables the close-button tooltip by default. Defaults to true.

elements.name: size
elements.description: Default toast size using the shared sm, md, or lg values.

elements.name: toastText
elements.description: Overrides the default accessible text for the close button and toast type icons.

elements.name: children
elements.description: The application content rendered inside the provider.

toast.description: useToast returns methods for creating and dismissing toasts. It must be called within a ToastProvider.

elements.name: success / error / info / warning
elements.description: Creates a toast of the corresponding type from a React message and optional ToastOptions. Each method returns the toast identifier.

elements.name: message
elements.description: The toast content. It accepts any React node, including text, markup, and interactive elements.

elements.name: duration
elements.description: Per-toast display duration in milliseconds. A value of 0 keeps the toast visible until dismissed.

elements.name: exitDuration
elements.description: Per-toast exit animation duration in milliseconds.

elements.name: tooltip
elements.description: Enables or disables the close-button tooltip for this toast.

elements.name: size
elements.description: Overrides the provider size for this toast.

elements.name: toastText
elements.description: Overrides accessible labels for this toast's type icon and close button.

elements.name: onClose
elements.description: Called when the toast begins dismissal, whether it is dismissed automatically or through dismiss.

elements.name: dismiss
elements.description: Dismisses a toast using the identifier returned by a creation method.

accessibility.general: The provider renders a live toast viewport with aria-live="polite" and aria-relevant="additions". Toasts pause while hovered or focused and can be dismissed with the Escape key or close button.
elements: Keep toast messages concise and do not rely on color or the status icon alone to communicate meaning.
Provide accessible text for interactive content included in a toast, such as buttons or links.
Customize toastText when the default status or close labels do not fit the application language or context.
Use a persistent toast only when it contains a clear dismissal action or another way for users to close it.
